title: Power Apps: consolidated AI settings for model-driven apps in Maker Studio and Copilot hub
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft documents no automation for these environment controls is too broad. Microsoft documents the shared AI insight cards setting in its environment-management API, so the row-summary and legacy-control automation gaps need correcting; the roadmap facts, user licensing and listed UI paths are supported.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: no API paragraph
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API or automation for the environment-level row-summary control.
claims.quote:
GET https://api.powerplatform.com/environmentmanagement/environments/{environmentId}/settings?api-version=2024-10-01
EnvironmentManagementSetting: powerApps_EnableFormInsights | boolean
claims.fix: Remove the categorical no-API claim. Microsoft documents powerApps_EnableFormInsights in the environment-management settings API; the canvas data-grid article identifies EnableFormInsights as the shared AI insight cards setting, and record-summaries identifies AI insight cards as the same row-summary control. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/environmentmanagement/environment-management-settings/list-environment-management-settings and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/modern-controls/modern-control-data-grid#ai-row-summaries. If no complete configuration call can be documented in this row, omit the row rather than render its automation as undocumented, and retain its verified UI path in prose.
